name: Portofino
aero_highlight: Retractable hardtop with air-curtain front vents
description: Front-engined V8 grand tourer that replaced the California T, pairing a stiffer aluminium chassis with a folding hardtop.

name: 360 Modena
description: First production Ferrari built on an all-aluminium spaceframe, running a high-revving flat-plane V8.

name: Jesko Attack
aero_highlight: Top-mounted active boomerang wing (1400 kg downforce)
description: Track-focused Jesko built around serious downforce, using a huge active rear wing and deep front splitter.

name: Tourbillon
aero_highlight: Full-length Venturi diffuser & active rear wing
description: Post-W16 flagship mixing an 8.3-litre naturally aspirated V16 and three electric motors with a watchmaker-styled instrument cluster.

name: Chimera
aero_highlight: Agera RS aero package with Jesko powertrain
description: One-off commission built for Mohammed Ben Sulayem, dropping the Jesko's 1600 hp V8 and gated-style shift setup into an Agera RS.

name: Venom F5 Revolution Coupe
aero_highlight: Full-width adjustable carbon rear wing & dive planes
description: Circuit-leaning Venom F5 with extra cooling, firmer suspension geometry and heavy aero for fast corners.

name: Centenario LP770-4
aero_highlight: Extending active rear wing & rear-wheel steering
description: Centenary special marking Ferruccio Lamborghini's 100th year, adding rear-wheel steering and sharp carbon bodywork to the Aventador SV base.

name: W1
aero_highlight: Active Long Tail rear wing extending 300 mm
description: Follow-up to the F1 and P1, relying on ground effect and a 300 mm extending rear wing for 1000 kg of downforce in Race mode.

name: Zonda F
description: Fangio tribute using a 7.3-litre AMG V12, gated six-speed manual and plenty of exposed carbon and titanium.

name: B2
description: Early Russian mid-engine sports car with sharp jet-inspired lines, an aluminium spaceframe and a Cosworth-tuned turbo V6.

name: Reventon Roadster
description: Low-volume open-top car taking stealth-fighter styling cues and the Murcielago LP 670-4 SuperVeloce V12, capped at 15 units.

name: Gallardo LP570-4 Superleggera
description: Lightweight Gallardo running a 5.2-litre V10 and plenty of carbon-fibre parts to shave weight and sharpen response.

name: Imperium
aero_highlight: Sculpted low-drag bodywork & active rear wing
description: British electric hypercar pairing a carbon monocoque with big twin-motor punch and lightweight construction.

name: S1 Project
aero_highlight: LED light blades & sculpted side air channels
description: Modena-built coachbuilt V8 coupe with sharp retro-modern lines and a wraparound cabin.

name: Zonda Revolucion
aero_highlight: DRS rear wing & front hood flicks
description: Track-only Zonda evolution with a 6.0-litre AMG V12, DRS rear wing and a 1,070 kg dry weight.

name: S9
description: Twin-turbo V8 hybrid hypercar styled with Walter de Silva, aimed at sub-two-second sprints and 400 km/h pace.

name: Sesto Elemento
aero_highlight: Twin-scoop engine cover & large rear diffuser
description: Featherweight V10 special built around carbon-fibre construction to keep weight under a tonne.

name: Emira V6
description: Last petrol sports car from Lotus, using a supercharged 3.5-litre V6 and hydraulic steering for classic feel.

name: 12Cilindri Spider
aero_highlight: Active twin-flap rear aero & folding hardtop
description: Open-top front-mid V12 Ferrari revving to 9,500 rpm with a folding hardtop and active rear aero.
